text: Meet Hearly. The AI between your microphone and your meeting.
The keyboard. The café. The conversation nearby. They join in, too.
Your ideas deserve a clearer connection.
Train your voice on your Mac.
Hearly learns to recognize you, right on your device.
Turn Hearly on, and select Hearly Microphone in your meeting.
It filters background noise before your audio reaches the call.
Less distraction. More of what you have to say.
Join the Hearly waitlist at hearly dot live.
